title: An Empire Beneath the Cheese
description: A Chunky Cheese Token can open a road into Ratlantis, the lost rat empire preserved by the installed Rats progression. Enter it. Questlog observes Ratlantis's own dimension-entry advancement rather than replacing the portal or token mechanics.
description_completed: Ratlantis is no rumor. Its ruins, relics, and warlords are now part of the Overlord's field of conquest.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
